note: Array#join flattened nested arrays into one list of parts, so an empty nested array contributed no part and no separator: `[[], 1].join("-")` answered "1" where CRuby answers "-1". Pins the boundary on both implementations (the Lean builtin and __join_slow), through to_ary, and on a nested Array subclass that overrides length. Also pins Array#flatten, which walks the same recursive flattening and must keep dropping the empty nested arrays.
